name: subagent
summary: Delegate tasks to specialized subagents in isolated context windows. Single, parallel (concurrency-limited, optional background) and chain ({previous} threading) modes over JSON-mode pi subprocesses that load only the extensions the delegation guard grants (the parent's protections first). Built-in kit roles are always available; roles may set model, thinking, tools, skills (preloaded) and extensions. Esc cancels children. Also runs declarative workflows (packages/kit/workflows, ~/.pi/agent/workflows, .pi/workflows): deterministic step chains with a shared run directory, parallel groups, review gates and resume. The `workflow` tool runs JavaScript workflow scripts in a sandbox in the background (agent/parallel/pipeline hooks, journal and resume) and posts the result as a follow-up. A run given a result schema loads a child-only StructuredOutput tool and the host validates the submitted value itself.
